requirements: R1: Refactor EmployeeDossierController to reduce conditional nesting to max 3 levels and replace the fake summaryText PDF stub with a real multi-page document.
R2: Update AuthController.exchangeCodeForProfile to dispatch real network requests to Moodle and explicitly test 400, 401, and 403 error states.

slices.title: Resolve Integrity Stubs in Auth and Dossier Controllers
slices.jtbd: When implementing repairs for this epic, I want to replace the fake implementations in a single patch, so that the product functions securely without falsified success.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the backend codebase, When EmployeeDossierController methods are accessed, Then they execute with maximum 3 nesting levels and return a real multi-page PDF.
Given the Moodle SSO integration, When AuthController.exchangeCodeForProfile is called, Then it dispatches a real network request instead of returning mock data.
Given the integrated endpoints, When processing invalid or unauthorized requests, Then 400, 401, and 403 error states are explicitly handled and verified by tests.
